lines.en: label yasuchristmalloween1:
scene yasuquietroom1
: Io, can I ask you a question?
: No.
: Okay. Well, I’m going to do it anyway. Why does your Christmalloween costume make me so sad, yet also fill me with desire to ruffle your hair and call you a good girl?
: Likely because I’ve finally found the right blend between pitiful and cute. And that this is probably the most festive I’ve looked since I was an employee at Lawson.
: Can I ask you a question now?
: Yes.
: What are you even supposed to be?
scene yasuquietroom2
: I think her name is Ryza or something? I don’t really know, to be honest.
: I’m just throwing more darts at the millennial dart board to try and appeal to Sensei in hopes that I stop being shafted every Christmalloween and that he finally shafts me in the good way.
: Uta, what does it mean to be “shafted?”
scene yasuquietroom3
: Ignore me, Yasuyasu. That doesn’t mean anything. I’m just letting my emotions get the best of me again.
: Can I ask another question while we’re setting the table for this scene in a mostly figurative manner, yet also slightly literally since we just covered it with cookies and soda?
scene yasuquietroom4
: Yes!
: Why is she here?
scene yasuquietroom5
: Because the other room was too busy! Right, Yasuyasu?

: Right! It’s hard enough going to school and hearing the unseen orchestra of everyone’s blood. But it’s even harder at parties when the blood moves faster and sounds more like the inside of a demon’s intestines.
scene yasuquietroom6
: There’s your answer, Io. Demon intestines. You got a problem with that?
: Not particularly. I just assumed that I’d be the only one hanging out in the quiet room and that you’d show up intermittently to say hi because you feel bad about me being alone.
: That will still happen, I’m sure. There’s an adult I need to go seduce before ultimately backing out because hormones and history have combined to make me question every feeling I ever have.
scene yasuquietroom7
: But you’ll have Yasu in the meantime because Touka isn’t here today! Yay! For the Yasu thing. Not the Touka thing.
: Yay!
scene yasuquietroom8
: I understand that you do not like me — or girls at all, for that matter — so I promise to be as normal as I possibly can today in hopes that we can be friends.
: Well, as long as you know.
: Io! Surely you can muster a nicer response to Yasuyasu wanting to be friends with you than that!
: I really don’t understand why you keep putting so much faith in me when I have done nothing to warrant or earn it.
scene yasuquietroom9
: I’m sorry, Yasu. But if it makes you feel better, I’m your friend! I just also happen to be leaving you in a few minutes since I have a mission to commence.
: There’s no need to apologize. I am fully aware of my unwantedness and thank all of you for merely existing in the same space as me as even that is more than I deserve.
scene yasuquietroom10
: I think we might need to re-title the quiet room to the self-deprecation room if the trajectory of this conversation is at all indicative of what’s to come.
: Yasu’s probably the only girl who can keep up with me when it comes to self-hate. And that’s saying a lot since both members of dorm four actively harm themselves.
: Do we really need to bring that up right now? Christmalloween is all about having fun and spending time together!
scene yasuquietroom11
: ANYWAY, BYE!
scene yasuquietroom12
: Cool, yeah. I didn’t want you to say hi to him for me or anything. I’ll just hang out here with the evangelist. I’m sure that’ll go really well.
: Uta’s aura seems particularly thick today. Is this mission of hers truly that important to her?
scene yasuquietroom13
: Well, considering it’s the same mission like 75%% of our class has built themselves around, I’d say so. Yeah.
: You mean the sinful and disgusting pursuit of sexual intercourse with our teacher that seems to govern and guide the decisions of those who have yet to be touched by the light?
scene yasuquietroom14
: That’s actually a surprisingly adequate description when you leave out the stuff about “light” or whatever.
: Do you not desire to bathe in the same waters of wretched behavior that everyone else does?
: I don’t know. Is kissing and stuff part of those waters?
: I think kissing is probably okay.
: Then yeah. I think I’ll stay on land and let everyone else be eaten by sharks. I have no interest in that aspect of relationships.
scene yasuquietroom15
: Yay! This means we can bond over our virginities together!
: Yeah, I’m going to need you to, like...not ever say that again, please.
scene yasuquietroom16
: Well, don’t look all sad over it. I just don’t like that topic as a whole. We can still...talk about other shit so long as you don’t get all weird again. You haven’t been the worst so far.
: I have a hard time not becoming “weird” according to everything I have heard from our peers.

: Touka says the medication is supposed to help me with this, but I’m not sure how right she is if the threat of my transition still clings to the coattails of this conversation like spiders to their webs.
scene yasuquietroom17
: You’re on medication now? Since when?
: Um...perhaps since...last Christmalloween? I don’t really remember...
: Is not remembering a side-effect of your medication, maybe? What are you taking? Some sort of anti-psychotic?
: I just...take whatever I am given. I’m not sure what it is.
scene yasuquietroom18
: You should really try and find out. I don’t trust anyone enough to blindly consume whatever I’m given without doing proper research first. You should be the same.
: I think there are certain things that are simply beyond my understanding. And Touka won’t hurt me, so I think it’s okay to trust her...
: Life lesson, Yasu — you never know who is going to hurt you. And you can’t know why either because, sometimes, there’s no reason at all. Sometimes, people just want to hurt others.
: You’re a vulnerable girl. There’s no way around it. They can drug you with whatever they want and have complete control over you if you don’t take matters into your own hands and fight back.
scene yasuquietroom19
: What are you...suggesting I do then?
: A good place to start would be learning what you’re putting into your body at least. That way, you can make an informed decision about what’s right for you.
scene yasuquietroom20
: That is the aspect I understand the least...for all the things that seem right to me have been wrong to everyone else for as long as I can remember.
: Well, how about this? What’s your dream? What do you want to do? What’s something that would make Yasu happy?
: Safety from condemnation and a light that engulfs the world as we know it.
: Okay. Now, try that again, but say something that makes sense this time. Which I know you can. I’ve seen it happen before. Just be human.
scene yasuquietroom21
: Being human is hard when you are actually just a cockroach! No one will buy it no matter how hard I try!
: I’ll buy it. Just say something. What do you really want that’s attainable?
scene yasuquietroom22
: I would still like for you to be my friend.
scene yasuquietroom18
: Pass. Anything else?
scene yasuquietroom23
: I do not belong in this world...
: There’s no need to get offended. I already have two friends, which is honestly two more than I really want to be bothered with in the first place. There’s no way I could manage a third.
scene yasuquietroom24
: Besides, you don’t want a friend like me. Relationships are about mutual benefit and there is just literally nothing I can give you that you can’t get from anyone else.
: But I must become your friend if I am ever going to save you. That is my mission. And my mission must be completed if I am ever to become a-
scene yasuquietroom25
: God isn’t real.
: Yes He is.

: You’re wrong. And this “mission” that you’ve deceived yourself into both following and believing in is little more than a delusion of grandeur no different from the stuff that white girl in our class yells about all day.
: He is real, though. Sensei has seen Him and everything.
: Sure. And I hold the record for the fastest pitch ever thrown in the NPB.
scene yasuquietroom26
: That’s very impressive! Congratulations, Io!
: I can’t believe I deluded myself into thinking for a second that this conversation was actually going anywhere.
scene yasuquietroom27
: Hi again! I brought Miku here in exchange for information on Sensei’s whereabouts. Now, please excuse me while I put my tracking skills to the test!
scene yasuquietroom28
: Uhh...hey. You don’t mind if I chill here for a little while, do ya? Ain’t really feelin’ the whole noise thing tonight and Uta said you guys had a place I could kinda reset.
: Can you, like...put a jacket on or something first? There’s really no need for you to be dressed like that and you’re making me uncomfortable.
scene yasuquietroom29
: You’ve seen these mosquito bites up close and personal before. Or at least close enough to know they ain’t a threat. Just tell yourself I’m a boy or somethin’. I don’t care.
: I still feel like a jacket would be a demonstrably easier solution when the alternative is asking me to convince myself of anything.
: Baring one’s body before another before the sun sets is a sin that can only be redeemed by the flaying of one’s skin.
scene yasuquietroom30
: Agreed.
: Ain’t your religion thing the one where a guy’s gotta splooge in a girl to cure ‘em of devil AIDS or somethin’? Can that only be done at night?
scene yasuquietroom31

: The act of transference shan’t be misconstrued with recreational sex as it is done for the sole purpose of preserving humanity and protecting those who would normally partake in it from what is sure to come.
: So the splooge gives girls some kinda energy shield?
: Can you stop saying “splooge” please?
scene yasuquietroom32
: It is more like the splooge connects one entity to a greater one and subsequently marks them as worthy of redemption.
: Can you stop saying “splooge” please?!
scene yasuquietroom33
: What’s all the complainin’ for? Ain’t nobody sploogin’ on you, Io. And as the self-proclaimed splooge expert of the room, I ain’t changin’ for nobody.
: This is great news! It will make saving you easier! We must find Sensei at once!
scene yasuquietroom34
: Now, hold your friggin’ horsecock, Yasu. It ain’t nearly as easy as you think. There are certain...complication’s a girl’s gotta figure out how to deal with first.
scene yasuquietroom35
: HE CARES NOT FOR THE NARROW CREVICE THAT LIVES BETWEEN YOUR LEGS AND BECKONS THAT YOU BE TORN IN HALF TO SATE THE LUST OF THE CHOSEN ONE!!!
: I WILL TIE YOU TO THE BED MYSELF IF YOUR PATHETIC EXCUSE OF A CUNT IS RELUCTANT TO ACCEPT THE PHALLIC INVITATION OF HE WHO FUCKED THE WORLD ITSELF!!!
scene yasuquietroom36
: I’m sorry. I think it’s time for me to take my medication again.
scene yasuquietroom37
: Phallic invitation?
: Sorry for more sex talk, but it’s gonna be weird as hell when Sensei bones that girl.
: I feel like she’s either going to burst into flames or grow wings. I don’t think there will be a middle ground.
scene black
: I don’t even like girls, but I kinda wanna see it.
: Well, count me out. Want a cookie? Uta and I made them before the party.
: You didn’t drug ‘em, did you? Kinda scared of takin’ anything from you after ya kickstarted my wildly unpopular drug addiction arc.
scene yasuquietroom38
: Oh, Yasu. What were you doing in there? The party’s on the second floor.
: You didn’t accept some stranger’s invitation did you?
: Not this time. I was just doing what Touka said and trying to stay out of trouble, but I’m afraid that I may have accidentally created some again by being so worthless and broken.
: I’m sure it wasn’t that bad. What happened?
scene yasuquietroom39
: I probably shouldn’t say...it’s very inappropriate, I think...
: I’m sure I’ve heard ten times worse from Sensei.
: I’m sure you’ve said ten times worse.
: Either way, things slip sometimes, Yasu. It happens. I doubt it’s anything you need to get hung up on.
scene yasuquietroom40
: Then...
: It’s okay that I felt compelled to comment on the size of Miku’s vagina and how happy it would make God if Sensei were to have his way with her while I tied her to the bed?...
scene yasuquietroom41
: Okay. Time to go.
scene yasuquietroom42
: W-Wait a second, Akira! If Yasu’s on the verge of having another Yasu attack, shouldn’t we maybe take her with us? You know, so nothing worse happens?
: I’m sorry I’m always causing trouble for you. I don’t understand why I’m like this...
: I will not burden you by following you into the dark. I just ask that you do not tell Touka about this. She’d be so disappointed in me...
: We can’t leave her when she looks like that, right?
: Ayane...you do remember what we stepped aside to talk about, right? And how incorporating Yasu into that discussion would obviously make things even more convoluted?
: It’s okay...I’ll just go find a dumpster to crawl into and lock myself inside until the voices quiet down.
scene yasuquietroom43
: But if you could maybe come and unlock it if I can’t get myself out by tomorrow morning, I’d be very grateful...
: Seriously, though. How does she look so cute while saying such miserable things?
scene yasuquietroom44
: Hah...I don’t know, Ayane. I feel like this is something we should probably just keep between us, Makoto, and Yumi.
: Wrapping Yasu up in it on top of everything else she has going on just seems kind of cruel.
scene yasuquietroom45

: Then...maaaaaybe we can hold off on our “holy shit, what is going on?” talk for a little while? Like...until the party is over maybe? Like, there’s no need to rush, right? We have all the time in the world!
: Hahah...
: Ayane — what did Ami say to you when you guys were talking earlier? Because your attitude’s been a little different ever since-
scene yasuquietroom46
: C...Come on, Yasuyasu! Let’s take you somewhere you can rant and rave without the fear of your peers judging you for it!
scene black
It’s pretty clear that something Ami said did get to Ayane. And I’m sure I’ll squeeze it out of her sooner rather than later.
I just hope she doesn’t get to Maya next...
$ yasuchristmalloween1 = True
$ yasu_love += 1
Yasu’s affection has increased to [yasu_love]!
jump christmalloween3
